cards.public_summary: The Broncos added Jaylen Waddle in 2026 to bolster their passing attack, according to Fantasy On SI.
cards.evidence: While Nix suffered an ankle fracture in the playoffs last season, he’s been cleared to start in Week 1 against Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs. Even if Nix sees a slight decline in rushing usage as he returns from his ankle ailment, the Denver Broncos added Jaylen Waddle to bolster their passing attack in 2026.
cards.commentary: Waddle's move to Denver is worth monitoring because it puts him in a new passing offense, but the evidence does not establish his target share, role or chemistry with Bo Nix.
cards.author: Skyler Carlin
